from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from xarray.core.formatting import format_array_flat


class TestFormatArrayDUPairsCoverageHardQA:
    def test_format_array_du_pairs_coverage_case(self) -> None:
        arr = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70], dtype=np.int64)

        compact = format_array_flat(arr, max_width=11)
        wide = format_array_flat(arr, max_width=80)
        tiny = format_array_flat(arr, max_width=3)

        assert isinstance(compact, str)
        assert isinstance(wide, str)
        assert isinstance(tiny, str)
        assert len(wide) >= len(compact)
        assert len(tiny) <= 3

from xarray.core.formatting import format_array_flat

    if frame.f_code.co_name!='format_array_flat':
        return tracer
    if event=='call':
        last_def_stack.append({})
        return tracer
    if event=='line':
        ln = frame.f_lineno
        ld = last_def_stack[-1]
        # uses before defs on same line
        for v in sorted(uses.get(ln,set())):
            if v in ld:
                pair=(v,ld[v],ln)
                if pair not in seen:
                    seen.add(pair)
                    pairs.append(pair)
        for v in defs.get(ln,set()):
            ld[v]=ln
    if event=='return':
        last_def_stack.pop()
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
